name: mfds_drug_search
description: Search SOUTH KOREA's licensed medicines register (MFDS, Ministry of Food and Drug Safety; 식품의약품안전처 의약품통합정보) by Korean or English brand name, English active ingredient, or holder company: 한국 허가 의약품 검색. Returns per product: Korean and English brand name, holder, authorisation number and date, status (authorised / withdrawn / expired / cancelled), main ingredient, ATC code, prescription or OTC class, import or domestic. 15 per page, 1-based page. Zero matches returns empty_reason. Keyless. Example: mfds_drug_search({ query: "타이레놀" }) or mfds_drug_search({ query: "acetaminophen", by: "ingredient" })

query.description: Korean brand ("타이레놀"), English brand ("Tylenol"), English ingredient ("acetaminophen") or holder company

by.description: What the query is. auto (default): Korean text = brand name; Latin text = English brand name, then English ingredient if none.

limit.description: Max results from the page, 1-15 (default and max 15: the register pages by 15)

page.description: Page number, 1-based. Use next_page from the previous response.

name: mfds_drug_get
description: Full MFDS record for one Korean licensed medicine, by item code (품목기준코드, from mfds_drug_search): brand names, holder, authorisation number and date, status, ATC code, appearance, assessment type (generic / new drug), every active ingredient with amount and unit, excipients, barcodes, and links to the official efficacy, dosage, precautions and consumer-summary documents. Unknown code returns found:false. Keyless. Example: mfds_drug_get({ id: "202200658" })
